events.title: France remembers victims of 2015 Paris terror attacks
events.summary: France on Friday marks 11 years since the 2015 Paris terror attacks, in which more than 130 were killed as gunmen and suicide bombers attacked the Bataclan concert hall, a major stadium, restaurants and bars. France 24’s James André reports from outside the Bataclan where a tribute to the victims is being held.

events.title: Toera's homecoming: Madagascar's slain king joins his ancestors after 129 years
events.summary: In 1897, French colonial troops killed King Toera, ruler of Madagascar's powerful Sakalava kingdom of Menabe, and took his skull to Paris, where it remained hidden in a museum for more than a century. France returned the remains last year, and for the first time since his death, King Toera took his place among his ancestors during the Sakalava people's most sacred ritual.
